ko.title: 플라스틱 카드와 할부 결제: 증가하는 카드 잔액은 미국 가계에 대한 경고 신호인가?

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## 미국인들의 대출 방식에 대한 면밀한 분석

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: 차입 비용이 여전히 높은 수준을 유지함에 따라, 경제학자, 대출 기관, 가계 재정 관리자 모두의 관심을 다시 불러일으키는 세 가지 지표가 있습니다. 바로 신용카드 잔액, "선구매 후결제"(BNPL) 플랜 이용, 그리고 연체율입니다.

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: 이 세 가지 지표를 종합하면 미국 가계가 일상적인 재정을 얼마나 편안하게, 혹은 불편하게 관리하고 있는지 엿볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 각 지표가 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 집단이 가장 큰 압박을 느끼는지, 그리고 향후 대출 기관 및 규제 기관의 보고서에서 무엇을 주목해야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보이며, 개인적인 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## 카드 잔액이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: 뉴욕 연방준비은행의 분기별 데이터에 따르면, 최근 몇 년간 미국의 총 신용카드 부채는 명목상 기록을 계속 경신해 왔습니다.

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: 기록적인 잔액 자체가 반드시 경고 신호인 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: 물가, 임금, 차입자 수가 시간이 지남에 따라 모두 증가했기 때문에 잔액은 자연스럽게 상승하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: 더 중요한 것은 맥락입니다:

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **소득 대비 잔액.** 급여보다 빠르게 증가하는 부채는 급여와 비슷한 수준으로 증가하는 부채보다 더 강력한 재정적 부담의 신호입니다.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **이자율.** 평균 카드 APR(연이율)이 수십 년 만에 최고치 수준을 맴돌고 있어, 이월된 잔액에 대해 몇 년 전보다 매달 더 많은 비용이 발생합니다.

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **리볼빙 결제 대 전액 결제.** 많은 가계가 편의를 위해 카드를 사용하고 대금을 전액 결제합니다. 우려의 핵심은 매달 잔액을 이월하는 사람들에게 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## 선구매 후결제(BNPL): 편의인가, 숨겨진 위험인가?

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: BNPL 서비스는 쇼핑객이 구매 금액을 여러 번의 할부로 나누어 지불할 수 있게 해주며, 제때 결제하면 이자가 없는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: 이 서비스의 인기는 특히 젊은 소비자들 사이에서, 그리고 식료품, 의류, 전자제품과 같은 일상적인 품목에서 빠르게 증가했습니다.

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 투명한 조건과 짧은 상환 기간을 장점으로 꼽습니다.

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: 비평가들과 일부 소비자 옹호 단체들은 몇 가지 우려를 제기합니다:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **중첩 사용(Stacking).** 여러 BNPL 제공업체를 동시에 사용하면 총 부채 규모를 파악하기 어려워질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **제한된 가시성.** 과거에는 많은 BNPL 대출이 전통적인 신용 보고서에 완전히 반영되지 않았기 때문에, 대출 기관이 차입자의 부채 상황 전체를 파악하지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **연체료 및 미납.** 많은 플랜이 무이자이지만, 할부금을 제때 내지 못하면 위약금이 부과될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: 규제 기관과 신용 평가 기관은 BNPL을 보고 및 감독 체계에서 어떻게 다룰지 논의 중이며, 이는 향후 데이터에서 이러한 유형의 대출이 어떻게 나타날지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## 연체율: 조기 경보 지표

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: 연체율은 결제 기한을 넘긴 잔액의 비율을 측정하며, 일반적으로 30일, 60일, 90일 연체와 같이 기간별로 추적됩니다.

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 연체율이 대손상각과 같은 더 심각한 결과가 나타나기 전에 먼저 움직이는 경향이 있기 때문에 이를 면밀히 관찰합니다.

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: 최근 보고서에서는 몇 가지 패턴이 나타났습니다:

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - 카드 및 자동차 대출 연체율이 팬데믹 시대의 이례적으로 낮은 수준에서 상승했으며, 이는 부분적으로 역사적 정상 수준으로의 회귀입니다.

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - 심각한 연체로 이어지는 전환은 특정 집단에서 더 두드러지게 나타났습니다.

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - 학자금 대출 상환 재개는 많은 차입자에게 매달 새로운 상환 의무를 추가했으며, 이는 다른 부채로의 잠재적 파급 효과를 낳고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## 어떤 가계가 가장 큰 압박을 느끼는가?

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: 재정적 압박은 균등하게 분포되어 있지 않습니다.

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: 대출 기관과 연방준비제도의 데이터는 일반적으로 다음 집단에서 압박이 더 크다는 것을 시사합니다:

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **청년층:** 저축액이 적고 상대적으로 높은 부채 상환 부담을 안고 있는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **저소득 및 중산층 가계:** 임대료, 식비, 교통비와 같은 필수 생활비가 소득에서 차지하는 비중이 더 큽니다.

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **세입자 및 최근 주택 구매자:** 많은 임금 상승률보다 빠르게 오른 주거 비용에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **낮은 신용 점수를 가진 차입자:** 일반적으로 가장 높은 이자율을 부담하며 재융자 옵션이 거의 없습니다.

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: 반면, 고소득 가계와 낮은 금리로 고정금리 주택담보대출을 받은 사람들은 일반적으로 더 잘 보호받고 있으며, 이것이 전체 수치가 개인의 경험보다 더 안정적으로 보이는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## 대출 기관 보고서가 밝혀낼 수 있는 것

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: 앞으로 몇 주, 몇 달 동안 여러 출처가 추세를 명확히 하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **뉴욕 연준의 분기별 가계 부채 보고서:** 상품 및 연령대별로 잔액과 연체 전환율을 세분화하여 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **주요 카드 발급사의 실적 발표:** 순 대손상각률, 대손충당금 적립, 최소 결제액만 납부하는 고객의 비율 등이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **신용 평가 기관 및 BNPL 제공업체의 공시:** 할부 이용 및 상환 행동이 어떻게 변화하고 있는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **선임 대출 담당자 설문조사:** 은행이 신용 기준을 강화하고 있는지 완화하고 있는지 나타냅니다.

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.
segments.tr: 예상 대출 손실에 대한 충당금 증가, 더 엄격한 심사, 최소 결제액만 납부하는 행동의 증가는 경계심이 커지고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.
segments.tr: 안정적인 대손상각과 꾸준한 결제율은 소비자가 더 회복력이 있음을 나타낼 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?
segments.tr: ## 경고 신호인가?

segments.src: The honest answer is that the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 솔직한 대답은 상황이 복합적이라는 것입니다.

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.
segments.tr: 더 높은 잔액과 증가하는 연체율은 특히 가장 취약한 가계의 경우 주의가 필요합니다.

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: 동시에 많은 지역에서 고용은 비교적 견고하게 유지되고 있으며, 많은 차입자가 계속해서 대출금을 상환하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: 핵심 질문은 임금 상승과 인플레이션 추세가 부채를 유지하는 비용을 따라잡을 수 있는지 여부입니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## 가계를 위한 실질적인 조언

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.
segments.tr: - **이자율을 파악하세요.** 각 카드의 APR을 확인하고 가장 비용이 많이 드는 잔액부터 우선적으로 상환하세요.

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.
segments.tr: - **할부 플랜을 추적하세요.** 모든 BNPL 약정과 만기일을 간단한 목록으로 관리하세요.

segments.src: - **Build a small buffer.** Even a modest emergency fund can reduce reliance on credit during surprise expenses.
segments.tr: - **작은 완충 자금을 마련하세요.** 적은 금액의 비상금이라도 있으면 예상치 못한 지출 발생 시 신용카드 의존도를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Talk to your lender early.** If payments become difficult, many issuers offer hardship programs, and nonprofit credit counseling agencies can help.
segments.tr: - **대출 기관과 일찍 상담하세요.** 상환이 어려워지면 많은 카드사가 채무 조정 프로그램을 제공하며, 비영리 신용 상담 기관의 도움을 받을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Card balances, BNPL use and delinquency rates are best read together rather than in isolation.
segments.tr: 카드 잔액, BNPL 이용, 연체율은 개별적으로 보기보다 함께 읽는 것이 가장 좋습니다.

segments.src: They do not predict a specific outcome, but they do show where pressure is building and who is most affected.
segments.tr: 이 지표들이 특정 결과를 예측하는 것은 아니지만, 어디에서 압박이 커지고 있고 누가 가장 큰 영향을 받는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Watching the next round of lender reports will help show whether today's strain is a temporary squeeze or the start of a broader shift in consumer health.
segments.tr: 다음 대출 기관 보고서를 지켜보는 것은 현재의 재정적 압박이 일시적인 현상인지, 아니면 소비자 건강의 더 광범위한 변화의 시작인지 파악하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.

zh.title: 信用卡与分期付款计划：不断上升的信用卡余额是美国家庭的警示信号吗？

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## 深入观察美国人的借贷方式

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: 随着借贷成本持续高企，三个指标正重新引起经济学家、贷款机构和家庭预算管理者的关注：信用卡余额、“先买后付”（BNPL）计划的使用情况以及拖欠率。

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: 综合来看，它们为我们提供了一个窗口，可以观察美国家庭在管理日常财务时是感到轻松还是吃力。

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: 本文将解释每一项指标的含义，哪些群体最容易感受到压力，以及在即将发布的贷款机构和监管机构报告中需要关注什么。

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅供参考，不构成个人财务建议。

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## 为什么信用卡余额很重要

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: 根据纽约联邦储备银行的季度数据，近年来美国的信用卡债务总额屡创名义纪录。

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: 创纪录的余额本身并不一定令人担忧。

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: 随着时间的推移，价格、工资和借款人数量都在增长，因此余额自然呈上升趋势。

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: 更重要的是背景：

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **余额与收入的比例。** 债务增长速度超过工资增长速度，比债务与工资同步增长更能体现财务压力。

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **利率。** 平均信用卡年利率（APR）一直徘徊在几十年来的高点附近，这意味着与几年前相比，每月结转余额的成本更高。

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **循环还款与全额还款。** 许多家庭使用信用卡是为了方便，并会全额还款。关注的重点在于那些每月结转余额的人。

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## 先买后付：便利还是隐性风险？

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: BNPL服务允许购物者将购买金额分期支付，如果按时还款，通常无需支付利息。

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: 它们的受欢迎程度迅速增长，特别是在年轻消费者中，且常用于杂货、服装和电子产品等日常消费品。

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: 支持者指出其条款透明且还款期限短。

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: 批评者和一些消费者权益倡导者则提出了一些担忧：

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **叠加使用。** 同时使用多家BNPL服务提供商可能会让人更难看清总债务。

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **可见度有限。** 从历史上看，许多BNPL贷款并未完全反映在传统的信用报告中，因此贷款机构可能无法全面了解借款人的债务情况。

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **滞纳金和逾期还款。** 虽然许多计划是免息的，但如果错过分期付款，可能会产生罚款。

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: 监管机构和征信机构一直在研究如何在报告和监管中处理BNPL，这可能会改变此类借贷在未来数据中的呈现方式。

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## 拖欠率：早期预警指标

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: 拖欠率衡量的是逾期还款的余额比例，通常按逾期30天、60天或90天等区间进行跟踪。

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: 分析师密切关注这些指标，因为它们往往在出现核销等更严重后果之前就会发生变化。

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: 最近的报告指出了一些模式：

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - 信用卡和汽车贷款的拖欠率已从疫情期间异常低的水平上升，部分原因是回归历史常态。

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - 在某些群体中，向严重拖欠状态的转变比其他群体更为明显。

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - 学生贷款还款的恢复为许多借款人增加了另一项每月义务，并可能波及其他债务。

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## 哪些家庭感受到的压力最大？

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: 压力并非均匀分布。

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: 来自贷款机构和美联储的数据普遍表明，以下群体的压力更大：

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **年轻人**，他们通常储蓄较少，且相对债务支出较高。

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **中低收入家庭**，租金、食品和交通等基本生活开支占其收入的比例更大。

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **租房者和近期购房者**，他们面临的住房成本上涨速度快于许多人的工资增长速度。

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **信用评分较低的借款人**，他们通常面临最高的利率，且再融资的选择最少。

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: 相比之下，高收入家庭以及以较低利率锁定固定利率抵押贷款的家庭通常受到的影响较小，这也是为什么总体数据看起来比个人经历更稳定的原因之一。

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## 贷款机构报告可能揭示什么

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: 在接下来的几周和几个月里，几个来源可能有助于厘清这一趋势：

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **纽约联储的季度家庭债务报告**，该报告按产品和年龄组细分了余额和拖欠情况。

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **主要信用卡发行商的财报评论**，包括净核销率、准备金计提以及仅支付最低还款额的客户比例。

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **征信机构和BNPL提供商的披露信息**，可以显示分期付款的使用和还款行为是如何演变的。

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **高级贷款官员调查**，这表明银行是在收紧还是放宽信贷标准。

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.
segments.tr: 为预期贷款损失增加准备金、更严格的承销标准以及仅支付最低还款额的行为增加，都表明谨慎情绪在增长。

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.
segments.tr: 稳定的核销率和稳定的还款率则表明消费者更具韧性。

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?
segments.tr: ## 这是一个警示信号吗？

segments.src: The honest answer is that the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 诚实的回答是，情况喜忧参半。

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.
segments.tr: 更高的余额和上升的拖欠率值得关注，特别是对于风险敞口最大的家庭而言。

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: 与此同时，许多地区的就业状况保持相对稳固，许多借款人继续按时还款。

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: 关键问题在于工资增长和通胀趋势能否跟上债务负担的成本。

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## 给家庭的实用建议

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.
segments.tr: - **了解你的利率。** 查看每张信用卡的年利率（APR），并优先偿还成本最高的余额。

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.
segments.tr: - **跟踪分期付款计划。** 列出一份简单的清单，记录每一笔BNPL债务和到期日。

segments.src: - **Build a small buffer.** Even a modest emergency fund can reduce reliance on credit during surprise expenses.
segments.tr: - **建立小额缓冲资金。** 即使是一笔适度的应急基金，也能在遇到意外开支时减少对信贷的依赖。

segments.src: - **Talk to your lender early.** If payments become difficult, many issuers offer hardship programs, and nonprofit credit counseling agencies can help.
segments.tr: - **尽早与贷款机构沟通。** 如果还款变得困难，许多发行商提供困难援助计划，非营利性信贷咨询机构也可以提供帮助。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Card balances, BNPL use and delinquency rates are best read together rather than in isolation.
segments.tr: 信用卡余额、BNPL使用情况和拖欠率最好结合起来看，而不是孤立地看待。

segments.src: They do not predict a specific outcome, but they do show where pressure is building and who is most affected.
segments.tr: 它们并不能预测特定的结果，但确实显示了压力在哪里积聚以及谁受到的影响最大。

segments.src: Watching the next round of lender reports will help show whether today's strain is a temporary squeeze or the start of a broader shift in consumer health.
segments.tr: 关注下一轮贷款机构报告将有助于判断当前的压力是暂时的紧缩，还是消费者健康状况发生更广泛转变的开始。

hi.title: प्लास्टिक और भुगतान योजनाएं: क्या बढ़ता हुआ कार्ड बकाया अमेरिकी परिवारों के लिए चेतावनी का संकेत है?

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## अमेरिकी कैसे उधार ले रहे हैं, इस पर एक नज़दीकी नज़र

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: उधार लेने की लागत अभी भी ऊंची बनी हुई है, ऐसे में तीन संकेतक अर्थशास्त्रियों, ऋणदाताओं और घरेलू बजट बनाने वालों का ध्यान फिर से आकर्षित कर रहे हैं: क्रेडिट कार्ड बकाया, "अभी खरीदें, बाद में भुगतान करें" (BNPL) योजनाओं का उपयोग, और भुगतान में चूक की दरें।

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: कुल मिलाकर, वे इस बात की एक झलक देते हैं कि अमेरिकी परिवार अपने दिन-प्रतिदिन के वित्त का प्रबंधन कितनी सहजता से या असंतोषजनक रूप से कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि प्रत्येक उपाय हमें क्या बताता है, कौन से समूहों को सबसे अधिक दबाव महसूस होने की संभावना होती है, और आगामी ऋणदाता और नियामक रिपोर्टों में क्या देखना चाहिए।

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय सलाह नहीं।

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## कार्ड का बकाया क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: न्यूयार्क के फेडरल रिजर्व बैंक के त्रैमासिक डेटा के अनुसार, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में कुल क्रेडिट कार्ड ऋण ने हाल के वर्षों में बार-बार नाममात्र के रिकॉर्ड बनाए हैं।

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: अपने आप में एक रिकॉर्ड बकाया जरूरी नहीं कि चिंताजनक हो।

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: समय के साथ कीमतें, मजदूरी और उधारकर्ताओं की संख्या में वृद्धि हुई है, इसलिए बकाया स्वाभाविक रूप से ऊपर की ओर प्रवृत्त होता है।

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: संदर्भ अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है:

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **आय के सापेक्ष बकाया।** वेतन की तुलना में तेज़ी से बढ़ने वाला ऋण, उनके अनुरूप बढ़ने वाले ऋण की तुलना में तनाव का एक मजबूत संकेत है।

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दरें।** औसत कार्ड APRs दशकों के उच्च स्तर के करीब मंडराते रहे हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि एक ले जाए गए बकाये पर कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में हर महीने अधिक लागत आती है।

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **रिवॉल्विंग बनाम पूरा भुगतान किया गया।** कई परिवार सुविधा के लिए कार्ड का उपयोग करते हैं और पूरा भुगतान करते हैं। चिंता उन लोगों पर केंद्रित है जो महीने-दर-महीने बकाया रखते हैं।

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## अभी खरीदें, बाद में भुगतान करें: सुविधा या छुपा हुआ जोखिम?

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: BNPL सेवाएं दुकानदारों को खरीदारी को कई किस्तों में विभाजित करने देती हैं, अक्सर समय पर भुगतान करने पर कोई ब्याज नहीं लगता है।

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: उनकी लोकप्रियता तेजी से बढ़ी है, विशेष रूप से युवा उपभोक्ताओं के बीच और किराने का सामान, कपड़े और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स जैसी रोजमर्रा की वस्तुओं के लिए।

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: समर्थक पारदर्शी शर्तों और कम पुनर्भुगतान खिड़कियों की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: आलोचक और कुछ उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ता कुछ चिंताएं उठाते हैं:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **स्टैकिंग।** एक साथ कई BNPL प्रदाताओं का उपयोग करने से कुल दायित्वों को देखना कठिन हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **सीमित दृश्यता।** ऐतिहासिक रूप से, कई BNPL ऋण पारंपरिक क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट में पूरी तरह से प्रतिबिंबित नहीं होते थे, इसलिए ऋणदाता उधारकर्ता की प्रतिबद्धताओं की पूरी तस्वीर नहीं देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **देरी से शुल्क और चूके हुए भुगतान।** हालांकि कई योजनाएं ब्याज मुक्त हैं, किस्त छूटने पर दंड लागू हो सकता है।

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: नियामक और क्रेडिट ब्यूरो रिपोर्टिंग और निगरानी में BNPL का इलाज कैसे किया जाए, इस पर काम कर रहे हैं, जिससे यह बदल सकता है कि इस तरह की उधार भविष्य के डेटा में कैसे दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## भुगतान में चूक की दरें: प्रारंभिक चेतावनी गेज

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: चूक उन बकाए के हिस्से को मापती है जो भुगतान पर पीछे हैं, जिसे आमतौर पर 30, 60 या 90 दिन पुराने जैसे बकेट में ट्रैक किया जाता है।

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक इस पर करीब से नज़र रखते हैं क्योंकि वे चार्ज-ऑफ़ जैसे अधिक गंभीर परिणामों से पहले आगे बढ़ने की प्रवृत्ति रखते हैं।

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: हाल की रिपोर्टिंग ने कुछ पैटर्नों की ओर इशारा किया है:

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - कार्ड और ऑटो लोन पर भुगतान में चूक महामारी के दौर के अपने असामान्य रूप से निचले स्तरों से बढ़ गई है, जो आंशिक रूप से ऐतिहासिक मानदंडों की ओर वापसी है।

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - गंभीर चूक में संक्रमण कुछ समूहों में दूसरों की तुलना में अधिक स्पष्ट रहा है।

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - छात्र ऋण चुकौती की बहाली ने कई उधारकर्ताओं के लिए एक और मासिक दायित्व जोड़ दिया है, जिसमें अन्य ऋणों में संभावित फैलाव है।

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## किन परिवारों को सबसे अधिक तनाव महसूस होता है?

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: तनाव समान रूप से वितरित नहीं है।

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: ऋणदाताओं और फेडरल रिजर्व के आंकड़े आम तौर पर सुझाव देते हैं कि दबाव अधिक है:

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **युवा वयस्क**, जिनके पास अक्सर कम बचत और अधिक सापेक्ष ऋण भुगतान होते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **कम और मध्यम आय वाले परिवार**, जहां किराए, भोजन और परिवहन जैसी आवश्यक चीजें आय का एक बड़ा हिस्सा लेती हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **किरायेदार और हाल ही में घर खरीदने वाले**, जिन्हें आवास लागत का सामना करना पड़ता है जो कई मजदूरी की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ी है।

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **कम क्रेडिट स्कोर वाले उधारकर्ता**, जिन्हें आम तौर पर सबसे अधिक ब्याज दरों का सामना करना पड़ता है और पुनर्वित्त के लिए सबसे कम विकल्प होते हैं।

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, उच्च आय वाले परिवार और कम दरों पर तय किए गए निश्चित-दर मॉर्गेज वाले लोग आम तौर पर बेहतर तरीके से सुरक्षित रहे हैं, यही कारण है कि कुल आंकड़े व्यक्तिगत अनुभवों की तुलना में अधिक स्थिर दिख सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## ऋणदाता रिपोर्ट क्या प्रकट कर सकती हैं

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: आने वाले हफ्तों और महीनों में, कई स्रोत इस प्रवृत्ति को स्पष्ट करने में मदद कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **न्यू यॉर्क फेड से त्रैमासिक घरेलू ऋण रिपोर्ट**, जो उत्पाद और आयु वर्ग द्वारा बकाये और चूक के संक्रमण को तोड़ती हैं।

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **प्रमुख कार्ड जारीकर्ताओं से आय टिप्पणी**, जिसमें शुद्ध चार्ज-ऑफ़ दरें, आरक्षित निर्माण और केवल न्यूनतम भुगतान करने वाले ग्राहकों का हिस्सा शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **क्रेडिट ब्यूरो और BNPL प्रदाता खुलासे**, जो यह दिखा सकते हैं कि किस्त का उपयोग और पुनर्भुगतान व्यवहार कैसे विकसित हो रहा है।

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **वरिष्ठ ऋण अधिकारी सर्वेक्षण**, जो संकेत देते हैं कि बैंक क्रेडिट मानकों को कड़ा कर रहे हैं या ढीला कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.
segments.tr: अपेक्षित ऋण नुकसान के लिए बढ़ती आरक्षितियां, सख्त हामीदारी और केवल न्यूनतम-भुगतान वाले व्यवहार में वृद्धि बढ़ती सावधानी का सुझाव देगी।

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.
segments.tr: स्थिर चार्ज-ऑफ़ और स्थिर भुगतान दरें अधिक लचीले उपभोक्ता की ओर इशारा करेंगी।

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?
segments.tr: ## क्या यह चेतावनी का संकेत है?

segments.src: The honest answer is that the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: ईमानदार जवाब यह है कि तस्वीर मिली-जुली है।

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.
segments.tr: उच्च बकाया और बढ़ती चूक ध्यान आकर्षित करती हैं, विशेष रूप से सबसे अधिक उजागर परिवारों के लिए।

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: साथ ही, कई क्षेत्रों में रोजगार अपेक्षाकृत ठोस बना हुआ है, और कई उधारकर्ता भुगतान के साथ बने रहना जारी रखते हैं।

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: मुख्य सवाल यह है कि क्या मजदूरी वृद्धि और मुद्रास्फीति के रुझान ऋण वहन करने की लागत के साथ तालमेल बिठा सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## परिवारों के लिए व्यावहारिक उपाय

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.
segments.tr: - **अपनी दर जानें।** प्रत्येक कार्ड पर APR की जाँच करें और सबसे पहले सबसे अधिक लागत वाले बकाये का भुगतान करने को प्राथमिकता दें।

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.
segments.tr: - **किस्त योजनाओं को ट्रैक करें।** प्रत्येक BNPL प्रतिबद्धता और नियत तारीख की एक साधारण सूची रखें।

segments.src: - **Build a small buffer.** Even a modest emergency fund can reduce reliance on credit during surprise expenses.
segments.tr: - **एक छोटा बफर बनाएं।** एक मामूली आपातकालीन फंड भी आश्चर्यजनक खर्चों के दौरान क्रेडिट पर निर्भरता को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Talk to your lender early.** If payments become difficult, many issuers offer hardship programs, and nonprofit credit counseling agencies can help.
segments.tr: - **अपने ऋणदाता से जल्दी बात करें।** यदि भुगतान करना मुश्किल हो जाता है, तो कई जारीकर्ता कठिनाई कार्यक्रम प्रदान करते हैं, और गैर-लाभकारी क्रेडिट परामर्श एजेंसियां मदद कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: Card balances, BNPL use and delinquency rates are best read together rather than in isolation.
segments.tr: कार्ड बकाया, BNPL का उपयोग और चूक दरों को अलग-थलग करने के बजाय एक साथ पढ़ा जाना सबसे अच्छा है।

segments.src: They do not predict a specific outcome, but they do show where pressure is building and who is most affected.
segments.tr: वे किसी विशिष्ट परिणाम की भविष्यवाणी नहीं करते हैं, लेकिन वे यह जरूर दिखाते हैं कि दबाव कहाँ बढ़ रहा है और कौन सबसे अधिक प्रभावित है।

segments.src: Watching the next round of lender reports will help show whether today's strain is a temporary squeeze or the start of a broader shift in consumer health.
segments.tr: ऋणदाता रिपोर्टों के अगले दौर को देखने से यह दिखाने में मदद मिलेगी कि क्या आज का तनाव एक अस्थायी निचोड़ है या उपभोक्ता स्वास्थ्य में एक व्यापक बदलाव की शुरुआत है।

es.title: Plástico y planes de pago: ¿Son los saldos crecientes de las tarjetas una señal de advertencia para los hogares estadounidenses?

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## Un vistazo más de cerca a cómo se endeudan los estadounidenses

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: Con los costos de endeudamiento aún elevados, tres indicadores están atrayendo una atención renovada tanto de economistas como de prestamistas y planificadores presupuestarios familiares: los saldos de las tarjetas de crédito, el uso de planes de "compra ahora, paga después" (BNPL, por sus siglas en inglés) y las tasas de morosidad.

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: En conjunto, ofrecen una ventana a qué tan cómodamente, o incómodamente, están gestionando sus finanzas diarias los hogares estadounidenses.

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué nos dice cada medida, qué grupos tienden a sentir más presión y qué buscar en los próximos informes de prestamistas y reguladores.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento financiero personal.

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## Por qué importan los saldos de las tarjetas

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: La deuda total de tarjetas de crédito en los Estados Unidos ha establecido récords nominales repetidos en los últimos años, según datos trimestrales del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York.

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: Un saldo récord por sí solo no es necesariamente alarmante.

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: Los precios, los salarios y el número de prestatarios han crecido con el tiempo, por lo que los saldos tienden naturalmente al alza.

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: Lo que importa más es el contexto:

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **Saldos en relación con los ingresos.** La deuda que crece más rápido que los cheques de pago es una señal de tensión más fuerte que la deuda que crece en línea con ellos.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **Tasas de interés.** Las TAE promedio de las tarjetas han rondado máximos de varias décadas, lo que significa que un saldo arrastrado cuesta más cada mes de lo que costaba hace unos años.

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **Revolvente frente a pago total.** Muchos hogares usan tarjetas por conveniencia y pagan el total. La preocupación se centra en aquellos que arrastran saldos de mes a mes.

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## Compra ahora, paga después: ¿conveniencia o riesgo oculto?

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: Los servicios BNPL permiten a los compradores dividir una compra en varias cuotas, a menudo sin intereses si los pagos se realizan a tiempo.

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: Su popularidad ha crecido rápidamente, particularmente entre los consumidores más jóvenes y para artículos cotidianos como comestibles, ropa y electrónica.

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: Los defensores señalan términos transparentes y ventanas de pago cortas.

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: Los críticos y algunos defensores del consumidor plantean algunas preocupaciones:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Acumulación.** Usar varios proveedores de BNPL a la vez puede hacer que sea más difícil ver las obligaciones totales.

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **Visibilidad limitada.** Históricamente, muchos préstamos BNPL no se reflejaban completamente en los informes de crédito tradicionales, por lo que los prestamistas pueden no ver el panorama completo de los compromisos de un prestatario.

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **Cargos por mora y pagos omitidos.** Si bien muchos planes no tienen intereses, se pueden aplicar sanciones cuando se omiten las cuotas.

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: Los reguladores y las agencias de crédito han estado trabajando en cómo tratar el BNPL en la presentación de informes y la supervisión, lo que puede cambiar cómo aparece este tipo de endeudamiento en los datos futuros.

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## Tasas de morosidad: el indicador de alerta temprana

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: La morosidad mide la proporción de saldos que están atrasados en los pagos, comúnmente rastreados en grupos como 30, 60 o 90 días de retraso.

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: Los analistas observan esto de cerca porque tienden a moverse antes que resultados más graves como las cancelaciones de deuda (charge-offs).

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: Los informes recientes han señalado algunos patrones:

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - La morosidad en tarjetas y préstamos para automóviles ha aumentado desde sus niveles inusualmente bajos de la era de la pandemia, en parte un retorno hacia las normas históricas.

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - Las transiciones hacia una morosidad grave han sido más pronunciadas en algunos grupos que en otros.

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - La reanudación del pago de préstamos estudiantiles ha añadido otra obligación mensual para muchos prestatarios, con un posible efecto de contagio en otras deudas.

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué hogares sienten más tensión?

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: La tensión no se distribuye de manera uniforme.

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: Los datos de los prestamistas y la Reserva Federal generalmente sugieren que la presión es mayor entre:

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **Adultos más jóvenes**, que a menudo tienen ahorros más reducidos y pagos de deuda relativos más altos.

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **Hogares de ingresos bajos y moderados**, donde los elementos esenciales como el alquiler, la comida y el transporte ocupan una mayor parte de los ingresos.

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **Inquilinos y compradores de vivienda recientes**, que enfrentan costos de vivienda que han aumentado más rápido que muchos salarios.

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **Prestatarios con puntajes de crédito más bajos**, que generalmente enfrentan las tasas de interés más altas y tienen la menor cantidad de opciones para refinanciar.

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: Por el contrario, los hogares de mayores ingresos y aquellos con hipotecas de tasa fija bloqueadas a tasas más bajas generalmente han estado mejor aislados, lo cual es una razón por la que las cifras agregadas pueden parecer más estables que las experiencias individuales.

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## Lo que podrían revelar los informes de los prestamistas

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: En las próximas semanas y meses, varias fuentes pueden ayudar a aclarar la tendencia:

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **Informes trimestrales de deuda de los hogares** de la Fed de Nueva York, que desglosan los saldos y las transiciones de morosidad por producto y grupo de edad.

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **Comentarios sobre ganancias de los principales emisores de tarjetas**, incluidas las tasas de cancelación neta, la creación de reservas y la proporción de clientes que solo realizan pagos mínimos.

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **Divulgaciones de las agencias de crédito y proveedores de BNPL**, que pueden mostrar cómo están evolucionando el uso de cuotas y el comportamiento de pago.

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **Encuestas a altos funcionarios de préstamos**, que indican si los bancos están endureciendo o relajando los estándares de crédito.

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: Al mismo tiempo, el empleo se ha mantenido relativamente sólido en muchas áreas, y muchos prestatarios continúan cumpliendo con sus pagos.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: La pregunta clave es si el crecimiento salarial y las tendencias de inflación pueden seguir el ritmo del costo de cargar con la deuda.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## Conclusiones prácticas para los hogares

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: Card balances, BNPL use and delinquency rates are best read together rather than in isolation.

ar.title: البطاقات وخطط الدفع: هل تعد أرصدة البطاقات المتزايدة علامة تحذير للأسر الأمريكية؟

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## نظرة فاحصة على كيفية اقتراض الأمريكيين

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: مع بقاء تكاليف الاقتراض مرتفعة، تجذب ثلاثة مؤشرات اهتماماً متجدداً من الاقتصاديين والمقرضين ومديري ميزانيات الأسر على حد سواء: أرصدة بطاقات الائتمان، واستخدام خطط "اشترِ الآن وادفع لاحقاً" (BNPL)، ومعدلات التأخر في السداد.

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: مجتمعة، توفر هذه المؤشرات نافذة على مدى سهولة، أو صعوبة، إدارة الأسر الأمريكية لشؤونها المالية اليومية.

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال ما يخبرنا به كل مقياس، والمجموعات التي تميل إلى الشعور بأكبر قدر من الضغط، وما يجب البحث عنه في تقارير المقرضين والجهات التنظيمية القادمة.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة، وليست نصيحة مالية شخصية.

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## لماذا تهم أرصدة البطاقات

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: سجل إجمالي ديون بطاقات الائتمان في الولايات المتحدة أرقاماً قياسية اسمية متكررة في السنوات الأخيرة، وفقاً للبيانات الربع سنوية الصادرة عن بنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي في نيويورك.

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: الرصيد القياسي في حد ذاته ليس بالضرورة أمراً مثيراً للقلق.

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: لقد نمت الأسعار والأجور وعدد المقترضين بمرور الوقت، لذا فإن الأرصدة تتجه نحو الارتفاع بشكل طبيعي.

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: ما يهم أكثر هو السياق:

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **الأرصدة بالنسبة للدخل.** الدين الذي ينمو بشكل أسرع من الرواتب هو إشارة أقوى على الضغوط مقارنة بالدين الذي ينمو بما يتماشى معها.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **أسعار الفائدة.** حامت متوسطات معدلات النسبة السنوية (APR) للبطاقات بالقرب من أعلى مستوياتها منذ عقود، مما يعني أن الرصيد المرحل يكلف أكثر كل شهر مما كان عليه قبل بضع سنوات.

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **الرصيد المتجدد مقابل السداد الكامل.** تستخدم العديد من الأسر البطاقات للراحة وتسدد الرصيد بالكامل. يتركز القلق على أولئك الذين يرحلون الأرصدة من شهر لآخر.

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## اشترِ الآن وادفع لاحقاً: راحة أم مخاطرة خفية؟

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: تتيح خدمات (BNPL) للمتسوقين تقسيم عملية الشراء إلى عدة أقساط، غالباً بدون فوائد إذا تم سداد المدفوعات في الوقت المحدد.

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: نمت شعبيتها بسرعة، خاصة بين المستهلكين الأصغر سناً وللسلع اليومية مثل البقالة والملابس والإلكترونيات.

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: يشير المؤيدون إلى الشروط الشفافة وفترات السداد القصيرة.

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: يثير النقاد وبعض المدافعين عن حقوق المستهلك بضعة مخاوف:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **التراكم.** استخدام العديد من مزودي (BNPL) في وقت واحد يمكن أن يجعل من الصعب رؤية إجمالي الالتزامات.

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **الرؤية المحدودة.** تاريخياً، لم تكن العديد من قروض (BNPL) تنعكس بالكامل في تقارير الائتمان التقليدية، لذا قد لا يرى المقرضون الصورة الكاملة لالتزامات المقترض.

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **رسوم التأخير والمدفوعات الفائتة.** في حين أن العديد من الخطط خالية من الفوائد، يمكن تطبيق عقوبات عند تفويت الأقساط.

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: يعمل المنظمون ومكاتب الائتمان على كيفية التعامل مع (BNPL) في التقارير والرقابة، وهو ما قد يغير كيفية ظهور هذا النوع من الاقتراض في البيانات المستقبلية.

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## معدلات التأخر في السداد: مقياس الإنذار المبكر

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: يقيس التأخر في السداد حصة الأرصدة المتأخرة عن الدفع، والتي يتم تتبعها عادةً في فئات مثل 30 أو 60 أو 90 يوماً من تاريخ الاستحقاق.

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: يراقب المحللون هذه المعدلات عن كثب لأنها تميل إلى التحرك قبل النتائج الأكثر خطورة مثل شطب الديون.

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: أشارت التقارير الأخيرة إلى بعض الأنماط:

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - ارتفعت حالات التأخر في سداد البطاقات وقروض السيارات عن مستوياتها المنخفضة بشكل غير عادي في حقبة الجائحة، وهو في جزء منه عودة نحو المعايير التاريخية.

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - كانت التحولات إلى التأخر الخطير في السداد أكثر وضوحاً بين بعض المجموعات مقارنة بغيرها.

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - أضاف استئناف سداد قروض الطلاب التزاماً شهرياً آخر للعديد من المقترضين، مع احتمال حدوث تأثير غير مباشر على ديون أخرى.

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## أي الأسر تشعر بأكبر قدر من الضغط؟

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: الضغط ليس موزعاً بالتساوي.

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: تشير البيانات الصادرة عن المقرضين والاحتياطي الفيدرالي عموماً إلى أن الضغط أكبر بين:

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **الشباب**، الذين غالباً ما يكون لديهم مدخرات أقل ومدفوعات ديون نسبية أعلى.

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط**، حيث تشغل الضروريات مثل الإيجار والغذاء والنقل حصة أكبر من الدخل.

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **المستأجرون ومشترو المنازل الجدد**، الذين يواجهون تكاليف سكن ارتفعت بشكل أسرع من العديد من الأجور.

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **المقترضون ذوو درجات الائتمان المنخفضة**، الذين يواجهون عادةً أعلى أسعار فائدة ولديهم أقل الخيارات لإعادة التمويل.

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: في المقابل، كانت الأسر ذات الدخل المرتفع وأولئك الذين لديهم رهون عقارية ذات سعر فائدة ثابت ومثبتة عند معدلات أقل محمية بشكل أفضل بشكل عام، وهذا أحد الأسباب التي تجعل الأرقام الإجمالية تبدو أكثر استقراراً من التجارب الفردية.

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يمكن أن تكشفه تقارير المقرضين

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: في الأسابيع والأشهر القادمة، قد تساعد عدة مصادر في توضيح الاتجاه:

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **تقارير ديون الأسر الربع سنوية** من بنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي في نيويورك، والتي تحلل الأرصدة وتحولات التأخر في السداد حسب المنتج والفئة العمرية.

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **تعليقات الأرباح من كبار مصدري البطاقات**، بما في ذلك صافي معدلات شطب الديون، وبناء الاحتياطيات، وحصة العملاء الذين يسددون الحد الأدنى فقط من المدفوعات.

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **إفصاحات مكاتب الائتمان ومزودي (BNPL)**، والتي يمكن أن تظهر كيف يتطور استخدام الأقساط وسلوك السداد.

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **استطلاعات كبار مسؤولي القروض**، والتي تشير إلى ما إذا كانت البنوك تشدد أو تخفف معايير الائتمان.

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.
segments.tr: إن ارتفاع الاحتياطيات لخسائر القروض المتوقعة، وتشديد الاكتتاب، وزيادة سلوك سداد الحد الأدنى فقط من المدفوعات سيشير إلى تزايد الحذر.

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.
segments.tr: إن استقرار شطب الديون ومعدلات السداد الثابتة سيشير إلى مستهلك أكثر مرونة.

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?
segments.tr: ## هل هي علامة تحذير؟

segments.src: The honest answer is that the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: الإجابة الصادقة هي أن الصورة مختلطة.

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.
segments.tr: تستحق الأرصدة الأعلى وتزايد حالات التأخر في السداد الاهتمام، خاصة بالنسبة للأسر الأكثر عرضة للمخاطر.

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: في الوقت نفسه، ظل التوظيف قوياً نسبياً في العديد من المجالات، ويواصل العديد من المقترضين مواكبة المدفوعات.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: السؤال الرئيسي هو ما إذا كان نمو الأجور واتجاهات التضخم يمكن أن يواكب تكلفة تحمل الديون.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## دروس عملية للأسر

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.
segments.tr: - **اعرف معدل فائدتك.** تحقق من معدل النسبة السنوية (APR) على كل بطاقة وأعط الأولوية لسداد الرصيد الأعلى تكلفة أولاً.

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.
segments.tr: - **تتبع خطط التقسيط.** احتفظ بقائمة بسيطة لكل التزام (BNPL) وتاريخ استحقاقه.

segments.src: - **Build a small buffer.** Even a modest emergency fund can reduce reliance on credit during surprise expenses.
segments.tr: - **ابنِ احتياطياً صغيراً.** حتى صندوق الطوارئ المتواضع يمكن أن يقلل الاعتماد على الائتمان أثناء النفقات المفاجئة.

segments.tr: - **تحدث إلى المقرض الخاص بك مبكراً.** إذا أصبحت المدفوعات صعبة، يقدم العديد من المصدرين برامج للمصاعب المالية، ويمكن لوكالات الاستشارات الائتمانية غير الربحية المساعدة.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: Les prix, les salaires et le nombre d'emprunteurs ont tous augmenté au fil du temps, de sorte que les soldes ont naturellement tendance à augmenter.

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: Ce qui compte davantage, c'est le contexte :

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **Soldes par rapport au revenu.** Une dette qui augmente plus rapidement que les salaires est un signal de tension plus fort qu'une dette qui augmente en ligne avec eux.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **Taux d'intérêt.** Les TAEG moyens des cartes ont oscillé près de sommets inégalés depuis plusieurs décennies, ce qui signifie qu'un solde reporté coûte plus cher chaque mois qu'il y a quelques années.

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **Revolving versus paiement intégral.** De nombreux ménages utilisent des cartes pour des raisons de commodité et paient intégralement. L'inquiétude se concentre sur ceux qui reportent des soldes d'un mois à l'autre.

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## Acheter maintenant, payer plus tard : commodité ou risque caché ?

segments.src: BNPL services let shoppers split a purchase into several installments, often with no interest if payments are made on time.
segments.tr: Les services BNPL permettent aux acheteurs de diviser un achat en plusieurs versements, souvent sans intérêt si les paiements sont effectués à temps.

segments.src: Their popularity has grown quickly, particularly among younger consumers and for everyday items such as groceries, clothing and electronics.
segments.tr: Leur popularité a rapidement augmenté, en particulier parmi les jeunes consommateurs et pour les articles de tous les jours tels que l'épicerie, les vêtements et l'électronique.

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: Les partisans soulignent la transparence des conditions et les courtes périodes de remboursement.

segments.src: Critics and some consumer advocates raise a few concerns:
segments.tr: Les critiques et certains défenseurs des consommateurs soulèvent quelques préoccupations :

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Using several BNPL providers at once can make it harder to see total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Cumul.** L'utilisation de plusieurs fournisseurs BNPL à la fois peut rendre plus difficile la visualisation des obligations totales.

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
segments.tr: - **Visibilité limitée.** Historiquement, de nombreux prêts BNPL n'étaient pas entièrement reflétés dans les rapports de crédit traditionnels, de sorte que les prêteurs peuvent ne pas voir l'image complète des engagements d'un emprunteur.

segments.src: - **Late fees and missed payments.** While many plans are interest-free, penalties can apply when installments are missed.
segments.tr: - **Frais de retard et paiements manqués.** Bien que de nombreux plans soient sans intérêt, des pénalités peuvent s'appliquer lorsque les versements sont manqués.

segments.src: Regulators and credit bureaus have been working on how to treat BNPL in reporting and oversight, which may change how this kind of borrowing shows up in future data.
segments.tr: Les régulateurs et les agences d'évaluation du crédit travaillent sur la manière de traiter le BNPL dans les rapports et la surveillance, ce qui pourrait changer la façon dont ce type d'emprunt apparaît dans les données futures.

segments.src: ## Delinquency Rates: The Early-Warning Gauge
segments.tr: ## Taux de défaillance : l'indicateur d'alerte précoce

segments.src: Delinquency measures the share of balances that are behind on payments, commonly tracked in buckets such as 30, 60 or 90 days past due.
segments.tr: La défaillance mesure la part des soldes qui sont en retard de paiement, généralement suivis par tranches telles que 30, 60 ou 90 jours de retard.

segments.src: Analysts watch these closely because they tend to move before more severe outcomes such as charge-offs.
segments.tr: Les analystes les surveillent de près car ils ont tendance à bouger avant des résultats plus graves tels que les radiations.

segments.src: Recent reporting has pointed to a few patterns:
segments.tr: Les rapports récents ont mis en évidence quelques tendances :

segments.src: - Delinquencies on cards and auto loans have risen from their unusually low pandemic-era levels, in part a return toward historical norms.
segments.tr: - Les défaillances sur les cartes et les prêts automobiles ont augmenté par rapport à leurs niveaux inhabituellement bas de l'ère pandémique, en partie un retour vers les normes historiques.

segments.src: - Transitions into serious delinquency have been more pronounced among some groups than others.
segments.tr: - Les transitions vers une défaillance grave ont été plus prononcées parmi certains groupes que d'autres.

segments.src: - Student loan repayment resumption has added another monthly obligation for many borrowers, with potential spillover into other debts.
segments.tr: - La reprise du remboursement des prêts étudiants a ajouté une autre obligation mensuelle pour de nombreux emprunteurs, avec un débordement potentiel sur d'autres dettes.

segments.src: ## Which Households Feel the Most Strain?
segments.tr: ## Quels ménages ressentent le plus de tension ?

segments.src: Strain is not evenly distributed.
segments.tr: La tension n'est pas répartie uniformément.

segments.src: Data from lenders and the Federal Reserve generally suggests pressure is greater among:
segments.tr: Les données des prêteurs et de la Réserve fédérale suggèrent généralement que la pression est plus forte parmi :

segments.src: 1. **Younger adults**, who often have thinner savings and higher relative debt payments.
segments.tr: 1. **Les jeunes adultes**, qui ont souvent moins d'épargne et des paiements de dettes relatifs plus élevés.

segments.src: 2. **Lower- and moderate-income households**, where essentials such as rent, food and transportation take up a larger share of income.
segments.tr: 2. **Les ménages à revenu faible et modéré**, où les besoins essentiels tels que le loyer, la nourriture et le transport occupent une plus grande part du revenu.

segments.src: 3. **Renters and recent homebuyers**, who face housing costs that have risen faster than many wages.
segments.tr: 3. **Les locataires et les récents acheteurs de maison**, qui font face à des coûts de logement qui ont augmenté plus rapidement que de nombreux salaires.

segments.src: 4. **Borrowers with lower credit scores**, who typically face the highest interest rates and have the fewest options for refinancing.
segments.tr: 4. **Les emprunteurs avec des scores de crédit plus faibles**, qui font généralement face aux taux d'intérêt les plus élevés et ont le moins d'options pour le refinancement.

segments.src: By contrast, higher-income households and those with fixed-rate mortgages locked in at lower rates have generally been better insulated, which is one reason aggregate figures can look steadier than individual experiences.
segments.tr: En revanche, les ménages à revenu plus élevé et ceux ayant des prêts hypothécaires à taux fixe bloqués à des taux plus bas ont généralement été mieux protégés, ce qui est une raison pour laquelle les chiffres globaux peuvent sembler plus stables que les expériences individuelles.

segments.src: ## What Lender Reports Could Reveal
segments.tr: ## Ce que les rapports des prêteurs pourraient révéler

segments.src: In the coming weeks and months, several sources may help clarify the trend:
segments.tr: Dans les semaines et les mois à venir, plusieurs sources pourraient aider à clarifier la tendance :

segments.src: - **Quarterly household debt reports** from the New York Fed, which break down balances and delinquency transitions by product and age group.
segments.tr: - **Rapports trimestriels sur la dette des ménages** de la Fed de New York, qui décomposent les soldes et les transitions de défaillance par produit et par groupe d'âge.

segments.src: - **Earnings commentary from major card issuers**, including net charge-off rates, reserve builds and the share of customers making only minimum payments.
segments.tr: - **Commentaires sur les résultats des principaux émetteurs de cartes**, y compris les taux de radiation nets, les constitutions de réserves et la part des clients ne faisant que des paiements minimaux.

segments.src: - **Credit bureau and BNPL provider disclosures**, which can show how installment usage and repayment behavior are evolving.
segments.tr: - **Divulgations des agences d'évaluation du crédit et des fournisseurs BNPL**, qui peuvent montrer comment l'utilisation des versements et le comportement de remboursement évoluent.

segments.src: - **Senior loan officer surveys**, which indicate whether banks are tightening or loosening credit standards.
segments.tr: - **Enquêtes auprès des agents de prêt principaux**, qui indiquent si les banques resserrent ou assouplissent les normes de crédit.

segments.src: Rising reserves for expected loan losses, tighter underwriting and an increase in minimum-payment-only behavior would suggest growing caution.
segments.tr: L'augmentation des réserves pour les pertes sur prêts attendues, une souscription plus stricte et une augmentation du comportement de paiement minimum uniquement suggéreraient une prudence croissante.

segments.src: Stable charge-offs and steady payment rates would point to a more resilient consumer.
segments.tr: Des radiations stables et des taux de paiement constants indiqueraient un consommateur plus résilient.

segments.src: ## Is It a Warning Sign?
segments.tr: ## Est-ce un signal d'alarme ?

segments.src: The honest answer is that the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: La réponse honnête est que la situation est mitigée.

segments.src: Higher balances and rising delinquencies deserve attention, especially for the households most exposed.
segments.tr: Des soldes plus élevés et des défaillances croissantes méritent l'attention, en particulier pour les ménages les plus exposés.

segments.src: At the same time, employment has remained relatively solid in many areas, and many borrowers continue to keep up with payments.
segments.tr: En même temps, l'emploi est resté relativement solide dans de nombreux domaines, et de nombreux emprunteurs continuent de suivre leurs paiements.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth and inflation trends can keep pace with the cost of carrying debt.
segments.tr: La question clé est de savoir si la croissance des salaires et les tendances de l'inflation peuvent suivre le rythme du coût de la dette.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Households
segments.tr: ## Points à retenir pratiques pour les ménages

segments.src: - **Know your rate.** Check the APR on each card and prioritize paying down the highest-cost balance first.
segments.tr: - **Connaissez votre taux.** Vérifiez le TAEG sur chaque carte et donnez la priorité au remboursement du solde le plus coûteux en premier.

segments.src: - **Track installment plans.** Keep a simple list of every BNPL commitment and due date.
segments.tr: - **Suivez les plans de versement.** Gardez une liste simple de chaque engagement BNPL et de la date d'échéance.

segments.src: - **Build a small buffer.** Even a modest emergency fund can reduce reliance on credit during surprise expenses.
segments.tr: - **Construisez un petit tampon.** Même un fonds d'urgence modeste peut réduire la dépendance au crédit lors de dépenses surprises.

segments.src: - **Talk to your lender early.** If payments become difficult, many issuers offer hardship programs, and nonprofit credit counseling agencies can help.
segments.tr: - **Parlez à votre prêteur tôt.** Si les paiements deviennent difficiles, de nombreux émetteurs proposent des programmes de difficultés financières, et des agences de conseil en crédit à but non lucratif peuvent aider.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Card balances, BNPL use and delinquency rates are best read together rather than in isolation.
segments.tr: Les soldes des cartes, l'utilisation du BNPL et les taux de défaillance sont mieux lus ensemble plutôt qu'isolément.

segments.src: They do not predict a specific outcome, but they do show where pressure is building and who is most affected.
segments.tr: Ils ne prédisent pas un résultat spécifique, mais ils montrent où la pression s'accumule et qui est le plus touché.

segments.src: Watching the next round of lender reports will help show whether today's strain is a temporary squeeze or the start of a broader shift in consumer health.
segments.tr: Surveiller la prochaine série de rapports des prêteurs aidera à montrer si la tension actuelle est un resserrement temporaire ou le début d'un changement plus large dans la santé des consommateurs.

pt.title: Cartões e Planos de Pagamento: Os Saldos Crescentes de Cartões São um Sinal de Alerta para as Famílias Americanas?

segments.src: ## A Closer Look at How Americans Are Borrowing
segments.tr: ## Uma Análise Mais Detalhada de Como os Americanos Estão se Endividando

segments.src: With borrowing costs still elevated, three indicators are drawing renewed attention from economists, lenders and household budgeters alike: credit card balances, the use of "buy now, pay later" (BNPL) plans, and delinquency rates.
segments.tr: Com os custos de empréstimo ainda elevados, três indicadores estão atraindo nova atenção de economistas, credores e planejadores de orçamento familiar: saldos de cartões de crédito, o uso de planos "compre agora, pague depois" (BNPL) e taxas de inadimplência.

segments.src: Taken together, they offer a window into how comfortably, or uncomfortably, American households are managing day-to-day finances.
segments.tr: Considerados em conjunto, eles oferecem uma janela para quão confortavelmente, ou desconfortavelmente, as famílias americanas estão gerenciavdo as finanças do dia a dia.

segments.src: This article explains what each measure tells us, which groups tend to feel the most pressure, and what to look for in upcoming lender and regulator reports.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica o que cada medida nos diz, quais grupos tendem a sentir mais pressão e o que observar nos próximos relatórios de credores e reguladores.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informação geral, não de aconselhamento financeiro pessoal.

segments.src: ## Why Card Balances Matter
segments.tr: ## Por Que os Saldos de Cartões Importam

segments.src: Total credit card debt in the United States has set repeated nominal records in recent years, according to quarterly data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
segments.tr: A dívida total de cartão de crédito nos Estados Unidos bateu recordes nominais repetidos nos últimos anos, de acordo com dados trimestrais do Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York.

segments.src: A record balance on its own is not necessarily alarming.
segments.tr: Um saldo recorde por si só não é necessariamente alarmante.

segments.src: Prices, wages and the number of borrowers have all grown over time, so balances naturally trend upward.
segments.tr: Preços, salários e o número de mutuários cresceram ao longo do tempo, então os saldos naturalmente tendem a subir.

segments.src: What matters more is context:
segments.tr: O que importa mais é o contexto:

segments.src: - **Balances relative to income.** Debt that grows faster than paychecks is a stronger signal of strain than debt that grows in line with them.
segments.tr: - **Saldos em relação à renda.** Dívidas que crescem mais rápido do que os salários são um sinal mais forte de aperto do que dívidas que crescem em linha com eles.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Average card APRs have hovered near multi-decade highs, which means a carried balance costs more each month than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **Taxas de juros.** As APRs médias dos cartões têm oscilado perto de máximas de várias décadas, o que significa que um saldo rotativo custa mais a cada mês do que custava há alguns anos.

segments.src: - **Revolving versus paid-in-full.** Many households use cards for convenience and pay in full. The concern centers on those who carry balances month to month.
segments.tr: - **Rotativo versus pago integralmente.** Muitas famílias usam cartões por conveniência e pagam integralmente. A preocupação se concentra naquelas que carregam saldos mês a mês.

segments.src: ## Buy Now, Pay Later: Convenience or Hidden Risk?
segments.tr: ## Compre Agora, Pague Depois: Conveniência ou Risco Oculto?

segments.tr: Os serviços de BNPL permitem que os compradores dividam uma compra em várias parcelas, frequentemente sem juros se os pagamentos forem feitos no prazo.

segments.src: Supporters point to transparent terms and short repayment windows.
segments.tr: Os defensores apontam termos transparentes e janelas de reembolso curtas.

segments.tr: Críticos e alguns defensores dos consumidores levantam algumas preocupações:

segments.tr: - **Acúmulo.** Usar vários provedores de BNPL ao mesmo tempo pode tornar mais difícil ver as obrigações totais.

segments.src: - **Limited visibility.** Historically, many BNPL loans were not fully reflected in traditional credit reports, so lenders may not see the whole picture of a borrower's commitments.
